claim.purpose: Prepare #4741 for bounded v0.91.8 WP-15 Unity editor liveness and batch-proof reliability execution

initial.title: [v0.91.8][WP-15][unity][tooling] Make Unity editor liveness and batch proof reliable for deployed observatory
initial.goal: Make Unity Observatory editor and batch proof select a safe execution mode, show real progress, and fail quickly with precise evidence when the selected mode cannot complete.
initial.required_outcome: Repository-owned Unity proof wrappers deterministically select open-editor, fresh-batch, or skipped-fail-closed mode; isolate staged execution; monitor semantic progress; and retain exact proof or blocker truth.
declared_scope: Open-editor versus fresh-batch versus skipped mode selection
Approved staging and mutable Unity/.NET scratch isolation
Semantic log-progress watchdog and bounded blocker classification
Focused wrapper unit and contract tests
authority_boundary: #4741 owns editor liveness, proof-mode selection, staging, watchdog, cleanup, and wrapper tests
#4739 owns Unity-MCP project and endpoint identity
#5332 owns ILPP GetDomainName root cause and detailed retry classifier
No scene generation, fallback geometry, asset publication, runtime contract semantics, investor rendering, or walkthrough capture
No raw process scan, /private/tmp staging, scratch Unity copies, locally built owner binaries, or arbitrary total runtime ceiling
initial.task_boundary: Selectively port and finish only the editor/batch liveness and proof-wrapper surface from preserved predecessor work onto the current v0.91.8 base.
deliverables: Approved writable staged-project and scratch isolation
Focused wrapper unit and contract tests
Retained proof packet with mode and exact terminal outcome
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: every proof attempt prints open_editor, fresh_batch, or skipped_fail_closed before Unity work begins
AC-2: exact-project liveness uses permission-safe adl process status evidence and never broad ps, pgrep, or lsof output
AC-3: fresh_batch never opens the same project directory already owned by an editor and stages only under /Volumes/FastWork or issue-local .adl storage
AC-4: wrappers use repository-installed owner binaries and the configured Unity editor path without building replacement binaries
AC-5: progress monitoring keys off meaningful import, compile, validation, or terminal markers and does not impose an arbitrary total runtime ceiling
AC-6: crash, licensing, missing project, readonly database without subsequent import progress, idle progress, and routed ILPP signatures each produce a precise bounded outcome
AC-7: readonly-database text is not fatal after verified asset-import progress
AC-8: focused unit tests prove mode selection, progress reset, idle failure, readonly progression, cleanup, and #5332 routing without launching Unity
AC-9: one live or staged proof records editor version, canonical project, mode, progress classifier, log reference, and exact success or blocker truth
AC-10: the final diff excludes #4739 MCP alignment internals, #5332 ILPP diagnosis, Unity scene code, runtime semantics, asset work, and rendering polish
dependencies: Configured Unity 6000.5 editor path or later issue-approved baseline
#4739 only when open-editor proof requires MCP project/endpoint identity
#5332 owns any reproduced ILPP retry-loop diagnosis
WP-15 #5354 consumes final proof or explicit blocker
non_goals: Do not repair Unity-MCP project or port alignment
Do not diagnose ILPP GetDomainName root cause
Do not modify Unity scene builder or validator semantics
Do not add asset fallback or investor-facing polish
Do not build owner binaries or use scratch Unity processes outside the declared mode
Do not use /private/tmp or broad process scans
initial.plan_summary: Port only the current-base proof wrappers, formalize three execution modes, add deterministic progress/classifier tests, then run one focused live or staged proof and retain exact outcome truth.

steps.action: Review current wrapper contracts and selectively port mode selection, approved staging, scratch isolation, and progress-watchdog behavior from preserved predecessor work
Implement precise crash, licensing, readonly-progress, idle, and routed ILPP classifications without taking ownership of #5332 diagnosis
Expand focused no-Unity unit fixtures for mode selection, semantic progress, blocker routing, and cleanup
Update the bounded operator runbook and run one live or staged proof using the selected safe mode
Record bounded review findings and exact proof or blocker truth for WP-15 consumption

risks: Unity can keep logs active while repeating a non-progress startup loop
A live editor can own the same project directory targeted by batch mode
Readonly-database text can precede successful import and must be classified in context
The older candidate diff contains Unity scene changes outside #4741
Unity editor paths and installed versions can drift
invariants: Only one declared proof mode owns a project directory at a time
Semantic progress, not elapsed wall-clock alone, governs liveness
Staging and scratch state remain outside /private/tmp
Repository binaries remain the operational source of truth
Preserved predecessor work is not reset, overwritten, or silently absorbed
stop_conditions: The intended project is already owned and no approved editor-mediated proof exists
The configured Unity editor is absent or has an unapproved baseline
Execution requires #4739 MCP internals or #5332 ILPP repair
The proof requires Unity scene or runtime semantic changes
Staging cannot be isolated under /Volumes/FastWork or issue-local .adl storage
review_prompts: Does mode selection prevent concurrent ownership of one Unity project directory?
Does progress monitoring distinguish semantic progress from repeating log noise without an arbitrary total ceiling?
Are readonly database and ILPP signatures classified in the correct ownership boundary?
Can focused tests prove every wrapper branch without launching Unity?
Is the final diff free of MCP, ILPP root-cause, scene, runtime, asset, and rendering scope?
operator_constraints: Work only in the issue-bound v0.91.8 worktree
Preserve the older dirty #4741 worktree unchanged
Use /Volumes/FastWork or issue-local .adl for staging and repository-installed binaries only
No /private/tmp, raw process scans, arbitrary total runtime ceiling, raw gh fallback, or secret exposure

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove mode selection, semantic progress, blocker routing, and cleanup without launching Unity
Prove Observatory wrapper contract and issue-owned path integration
Retain one exact editor-mode or staged-batch outcome with semantic progress evidence
validation_lanes.defer_reason: Run only after the deterministic wrapper lanes pass and the operator-selected project is available; retain an exact fail-closed result when no safe mode exists.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove bounded text and shell hygiene

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on ambiguous project ownership, undeclared proof mode, arbitrary total-runtime ceilings, non-semantic log activity, unsafe staging, locally built owner binaries, adjacent Unity scope, or unsupported readiness claims.
